messages.author: ea2181c44dee3fa5
messages.subject: Subset values for boostrapping
parts:
Hi Guangchuang,

I am attempting to plot bootstrap values over 80 from a raxml tree. When I try to subset values >80 there are no problems, but when I got to plot the tree I get the following error.

> raxml <- read.raxml(file="out.RAxML_bipartitionsBranchLabels")
> tree <- ggtree(raxml) + geom_text2(aes(label=bootstrap, subset=bootstrap>80))
> plot(tree)
Error in scale_apply(layer_data, x_vars, "train", SCALE_X, panel$x_scales) :

Any help would be appreciated. Great package by the way, I find ggtree very helpful!!

Cheers.

Jessica

messages.author: f0dc0fdb872722c6
messages.subject: Re: Subset values for boostrapping
parts: ggtree(raxml) + geom_text2(aes(label=bootstrap, subset=(bootstrap > 80 & !is.na(bootstrap))))
